content: Human-labeling session — adv-asymmetric-weaker-must-win:hard seed 1. Objective: Two medium tanks must kill four rifle infantry walling the east-centre cluster while a heavy enemy tank holds post behind them; the heavy out-trades you head-on. Your tanks stage in either the north or south corridor (seed picks), so the working flank vector flips per seed, and the clock is tighter (about 50 turns). Keep one tank and your construction yard alive.
